_note: All formula weights for the Terrain scoring model. Edit here, not in scripts.

organizing_opportunity._rationale: 55/45 split between sectoral value and organizing potential. Pending regression validation.

organizing_potential._rationale: Part A: workforce size. Part B: sector mix. Part C: legal environment (RTW).

organizing_potential_thresholds._rationale: Unorganized workforce size tiers. Pending regression validation.

svs_normalization._rationale: B1: BOTH SLS paths now weight each sector by the FULL composite SVS (svs_formula, range ~10-60), not bare cap/comm reach. denominator (capital divisor) recalibrated 210000 -> 750000 so the top county (LA, 06037) still anchors at ~84 on 0-100 (new max raw SLS-Capital = 63,024,076 with composite weights; 63,024,076/750,000 = 84.03). community_multiplier (the SLS-Community share->0-100 scale factor) LIFTED FROM HARDCODE (was the ×4 literal at build_v2_canonical.py:111) and recalibrated to 1.875 so post-ramp SLS-Community max lands ~57 (≈ the prior ~56), no mass-clamping. PENDING SAM REVIEW — not yet merged.
svs_normalization._prior: denominator 210000 + hardcoded ×4 community multiplier, both calibrated to bare-reach weights (Agent D run, 2026-06-12).

electoral_composite._rationale: Weights for legacy electoral composite. Will be superseded by P1 formula in v2.0.

infrastructure_composite._rationale: Weights for infrastructure score used in intervention type classification.

strategic_terrain._rationale: Legacy terrain score weights. Stored but not displayed. Pending deprecation review.

strike_activity._rationale: Strike composite weights. Field is Phase 3 — not yet in county_scores.json.

svs_formula._rationale: SVS v6 formula. Locked. Changes require sector re-audit and full re-run approval.

p2_alignment._rationale: v2.0 target formula. Not yet implemented. Pending Phase 2 data sources.
